newsitem.title: UK: UK Japanese stocks ease on moderate profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: UK Japanese stocks ease on moderate profit-taking.

text.p: Japanese shares fell slightly on mild profit-taking ahead of an extended three-day weekend, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index was 0.89 points higher at 1,579.34 by 1344 GMT.
"There's been a bit of profit-taking ahead of the weekend particularly in the blue chip stocks which have had a good run recently," said one dealer.
Other dealers reported modest two-way business in selected blue chips stocks, notably Toyota, Canon and Hitachi.
